how_to_tell_apart: Bulgarian is the only language in this Cyrillic set that regularly writes ъ and щ and that uses ще for the future, какво for ‘what’, аз/съм, тук, защо, къде and благодаря. It has no ђ/ћ (Serbian) and no ѓ/ќ/ѕ or ќе/што/јас (Macedonian). Belarusian would instead show ў and і. Very common да, не, се and трябва also appear in Macedonian and Serbian, so they are not enough on their own.
